## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); Materials and Financials leading while Consumer Discretionary/Staples and Communication lag.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +26.43%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary lagging: NKE (1W: -14.57% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, TGT (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +7.62%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples weak: PEP (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -3.92% | 1M: +5.51%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +26.43%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +8.37%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Materials and Financials strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NKE (1W: -14.57% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -3.97% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -3.96% | 1M: -4.32%) BELOW TREND, PSA (1W: -3.01% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Consumer-facing and select Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +26.43%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND. Note GILD (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -0.49%) in RECOVERY — 1W/1M divergence is a tactical setup, not full trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but constructive: NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +0.32%) CORRECTION. Technology showing rotation into select winners rather than broad-led breakout.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials leading and broad: JPM (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth supports Risk Rotation toward cyclicals and banks.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed: MRK (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +8.37%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -0.49%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -2.81% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION. Watch headline-driven dispersion within the sector.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Materials exposure given broad leadership and momentum in cyclicals; reduce exposure to weak Consumer Discretionary/Staples and lagging Communication names. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt while monitoring tech winners for momentum trades.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -14.57% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +9.46%) and Financials (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76%) on leadership and news flow. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.84% | 1M: +5.95%) and Communication (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -0.93%) for continued pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for continuation above this week’s highs to confirm tech momentum; FCX holding recent breakout and 1M strength would confirm Materials leadership; JPM sustaining >1W gains would confirm Financials rotation; AAPL failing to reclaim its 1M trend would keep tech leadership selective.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
FCX (+50): "Copper Is the New Gold" — FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. NEM (+55): Gold/silver surge headline — NEM (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +26.43%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. JPM (+50): Institutional crypto access headline — JPM (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (-75): Patient death in trial — PFE (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. META (-45): price-target cuts — META (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +11.99%) ABOVE TREND, bearish headlines diverge from price (distribution risk). LLY (-45): GLP-1 competition headline — LLY (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.13%) ABOVE TREND, headlines are a divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Value/Cyclical tilt as Materials and Financials lead; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: headline-driven divergences in Healthcare and select Tech (META, LLY, PFE) may presage tactical rotation — monitor news-confirmation vs price action.
